scope: WMF -> SVG (Raster_Encode format 24) differences found by zlib-functional-pass2; four-way comparison
inputs: 2 ONLYOFFICE core MathEquation example WMFs + 2 Microsoft Office clipart WMFs (read-only)

rebuilt_zlib_2026_source.threw: null function or function signature mismatch

finding_source_drift: For image1.wmf, AN00010_.WMF and AN00790_.WMF the rebuilt zlib output is byte-identical to the rebuilt fonts output (same 2026 core source), while the official zlib (2022) and the official fonts (2025-12) each differ: the SVG writer changed between source versions. Not a rebuild defect.

finding_null_font_manager.symptom: rebuilt zlib traps on image10.wmf with 'null function or function signature mismatch'
finding_null_font_manager.root_cause: graphics/pro/js/qt/raster/raster.cpp Raster_Encode calls MetaFile::Create(NULL); CMetaFile then has m_pFontManager == NULL (raster/Metafile/MetaFile.cpp constructor); CInterpretatorSvgBase.cpp:336 (WMF) and CEmfInterpretatorSvg.cpp:1255 (EMF) call m_pParser->GetFontManager()->GetFontInfoByParams() without a null check: a virtual call through a null pointer (undefined behaviour). In wasm it reads a function index from low memory: the rebuilt zlib traps, the rebuilt fonts engine happens to call some function and emits output, so that output is not trustworthy either.
finding_null_font_manager.present_since: already at 075052dd (CInterpretatorSvgBase.cpp:298, CEmfInterpretatorSvg.cpp:1220); upstream file history shows later edits up to 2026-10-07 without adding the check
finding_null_font_manager.affects: WMF/EMF images that contain text, converted to SVG inside the WASM engines (fonts and zlib) with no application fonts
finding_null_font_manager.status: upstream source defect inherited by the rebuild; not patched; fix requires a first-party patch decision by the user
